name: switch
useFor: Use for a setting that applies at once, such as a map layer (Terrain). Pass the label as children. Use size sm in dense rows. For an option applied on submit use Checkbox.
constraints: A switch that needs a Save key to apply
source: Figma "UI · Controls" (442:145), where it is called Toggle: Terrain, on and off
title: Switch
description: A square 32 by 16 track with no cut: Bone with a Stone line and a Mist knob when off, Forest with a Bone knob when on. The knob slides in 200ms on the strong ease-out; the track's color fades over 150ms. Its label is 13px Forest 12px after it.
